technology_name: METHOD FOR SELECTIVE AND SENSITIVE QUANTIFICATION OF HYDROGEN SULFIDE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional H2S detection systems are slow, destroy the sample, or suffer from signal fading. This provides ultra-fast regeneration (< 1 minute) without losing sensitivity.
description: A fast two-step chemical analytical protocol utilizing structurally tailored Malachite Green derivatives to selectively bind, isolate, and quantify hydrogen sulfide traces.
applications: Laboratory diagnostics, Real-time clinical biomarker monitoring, Wastewater trace gas assessment, Industrial toxic gas safety kits.
